title: Azure Blob Storage Account
description: Secure storage account with private blob container, infrastructure double-encryption, TLS 1.2 enforcement, and public access blocked

storage_name_prefix.title: Storage Account Name Prefix
storage_name_prefix.description: Prefix for the storage account name (3-16 lowercase alphanumerics; a random suffix is appended for global uniqueness)

container_name.title: Blob Container Name
container_name.description: Name of the blob container created inside the storage account

resource_group_name.title: Resource Group Name
resource_group_name.description: Existing resource group hosting the storage account (typically an output of the Azure VNet template)

location.title: Azure Region
location.description: Azure region where the storage account will be deployed

replication_type.title: Replication Strategy
replication_type.description: Storage replication strategy: Locally-redundant, Zone-redundant, Geo-redundant, or Read-access geo-redundant

enable_versioning.title: Enable Blob Versioning
enable_versioning.description: Enable object versioning for rollback and disaster recovery

shared_access_key_enabled.title: Allow Shared Key Access
shared_access_key_enabled.description: Permit shared key authorization (leave disabled to enforce Azure AD / Entra ID-only access)
